fields.label: QRadar console host
fields.description: QRadar console host only, e.g. qradar.example.com — no scheme or path (Crogl adds https:// and /api).

fields.label: API token (SEC)
fields.description: QRadar authorized-service token, created under Admin -> Authorized Services. Injected server-side as the SEC header.

fields.label: Skip TLS verification
fields.description: Skip TLS certificate verification (for self-signed certs).
